The Autumn Stroll Market will be held on November 15, 2026 (Reiwa 8) in the Kurosashi-Hosoda district, a mountain village community in Hanno. As you walk along the mountain paths, you can purchase seasonal farm produce and handmade goods displayed at residents' homes, and enjoy meeting and chatting with the local community.
